facts.fact: A Central Bank of Egypt source told Al-Mezan the bank has licensed telecom companies to provide international transfer services through e-wallets, under regulatory controls.
facts.system: Vodafone Cash and Etisalat Cash international transfers

EGY.note: The mention of user rights in the licensing controls states no rule, complaints body or enforcement.
No core government system is mentioned.

facts.fact: A Central Bank of Egypt source says international transfers through mobile wallets work for receiving money into Egypt only, not sending abroad, through Vodafone Cash and Etisalat Cash with licensed international money transfer firms.
facts.system: Vodafone Cash and Etisalat Cash international receipt

EGY.note: No government payments to people are mentioned.
No account ownership survey is mentioned.

facts.fact: A Central Bank of Egypt source and the report describe the Vodafone Cash and Etisalat Cash mobile wallets as operating, receiving international transfers for people in Egypt.

EGY.note: No tax or fee payment is mentioned.
